name: Ring Chandelier Lamp
desc: A contemporary multi-ring LED chandelier featuring three suspended circular light rings arranged at different diameters and heights. The fixture uses a dark metallic frame with integrated diffused light strips, creating a modern sculptural ceiling centerpiece.

specifications.Ring Arrangement: Three concentric circular rings with different diameters and vertical positions
specifications.Diffuser: Continuous diffused light strip integrated into the rings
specifications.Finish: Dark metallic / black finish with warm white illuminated rings
specifications.Recommended Use: Living room / Dining room / Lobby / Lounge / Contemporary interiors
